description: New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology publishes processed uncrewed-aircraft measurements and methane-flux estimates for controlled releases and infrastructure emission sources. The August 2024 archive and linked repository provide levels zero to two, intermediate transect products and a flux-rates CSV supporting the published figures and table. Examples include New Mexico landfill, wastewater and oil-and-gas sites, with controlled-release tests in Arizona; field examples span 2022–2023. Files are free under CC BY 4.0. The observations can calibrate plume-transport or source-emission simulations and compare methane with ethane for source attribution. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Separate software deposits implement background correction and wind adjustment. The primary paper notes sensitivity to meteorology and possible underestimation where transects miss part of a plume. Individual file completeness, uncertainty propagation and claimed measurement accuracy were not independently checked. Python 3.11 generated the documented processing products.
